_comment: 游魂的 AI 生成外观（ai3d-enemies，g01）的来源记录。源 GLB、概念图、UniRig 的权重 GLB 都不进仓库，只记 sha256（存放在私有的 cinder-ai-src）；art/ai/hero_rig.py 按 art/ai/enemy/g01.json 生成 husk.glb（高 / 中画质）和 husk_lo.glb（低画质的减面版），骨骼集合同现网 Zombie（41 根，标准名），pack-assets 打进 js/assets/chars.js（aihusk_hi / aihusk_lo）；没有源文件的机器上保留已提交的 GLB。

concept_image.use: 没有用（只用源 GLB 的反照率）

generation.prompt: full body, standing straight, A-pose, arms held clearly away from the body (about 30-45 degrees), open hands with long thin fingers, legs straight and slightly apart, facing the viewer, not crouching, not in a fighting stance, a gaunt undead humanoid made of ash and cinder, clearly hunched rounded shoulders and a forward-jutting head, back slightly curved, very thin limbs and long arms reaching past the hips, ragged ash-grey and grey-brown cloth strips hanging from the shoulders and waist, pale light ash-grey skin all over the body, arms and legs, covered in thin dark cracks with faint ember-orange light glowing inside them, two small glowing ember eye points in a hollow face, no hair, no weapon, empty hands, adult human proportions with a small head (about one seventh of the height), single creature, symmetric, A-pose or rest pose, plain white background, stylized low-poly toon game character, adult proportions, clean flat colour blocks, soft simple shading, matte, original design, no text, no logos, no emblems
generation.nodes: 全部是 ComfyUI 内置节点（comfy_extras/nodes_trellis2.py、nodes_bg_removal.py、nodes_mesh_postprocess.py），没有自定义节点

licences.outputs: 组件的许可证都不限制生成物（见 cinder-ai-src/README.md 和 game-workspace notes/ai3d/licence-audit.md）；DINOv3 License 要求注明 Built with DINOv3
licences.tools_only: ComfyUI GPL-3.0、UniRig 内嵌的 michelangelo GPL-3.0 只在本地当工具跑，不随游戏分发

skinning.tool: UniRig（skin-only，使用 devbox 拟合的骨架）

unirig.license: MIT（内嵌 michelangelo 为 GPL-3.0，仅本地当工具运行）
